Ridiculous Grind. The math break down is for all non bid gift cards Amazon $150 gift cards etc. Max you can earn is 10,000 carrots a day which is 10,000 steps. 10,000 x 365 = 3,650,000 A year. $150 gift card is 15m carrots. 15,000,000\3,650,000 = 4.10. So you would be seeing $150 gift card every four years and some change. That is a horrible return considering these guys are probably selling as much of the users data as possible. Sweatcoin is a grind, LifeCoin is a grind as well.. but there math comes out to about 1000 dollars every 36months. That is far better. Much more worth it. Again most of these apps are gonna sell off as much data as possible we the users should at least get some what of a chuck of that. The other option to use your carrots is through auctions these normally consist of $5 gift cards that’s usually end bids around 3m to 6m. So if you are going to grind it out I would recommend just sticking out the four years to get the $150 over a year and half for $5. Anyways I’ll give them one star for the user interface it’s not bad. Simply, check out lympo everyone best app around.
